title: SOLID: A Large-Scale Semi-Supervised Dataset for Offensive Language Identification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification performance (macro-F1 scores) on 'Hard' versus 'Easy' subsets of tweets, where 'Hard' tweets contain covert offensive language driven by negative biases rather than explicit profanity or curse words.

Evaluating models on the OLID Level C taxonomy, which measures the ability to classify whether an offensive tweet explicitly targets a demographic group based on shared characteristics such as ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, or religion.
